Darkglass Electronics browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive fuzz browse by enclosure pedal Darkglass Electronics Duality - Dual Fuzz Engine Published on October 15, 2013 Darkglass Electronics fuzz pedal Information Darkglass Electronics The Duality Fuzz is a combination of two totally independent fuzz circuits! Our signature Duality knob allows selecting and blending between a classic sounding, saw-tooth shape shifting circuit and a high gain, thick and brutal one. You can use them individually or blend them for a wide selection of crazy and wild textures and voicings. And as if that wasn't enough, use the Blend knob to add in some clean signal for 3 layers of fat, thick madness.
